rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: itnet_k=1, unet_c=32, itnet_alpha_init=0.0026, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=0.00025, pretrain_epochs=15, pretrain_patience=15, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=2400, val_n=200, seed=42, rationale=ITER-6 (breast itnet_v2 search-20260703-01, 20-min budget, extend to iter-20). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, corrected authoritative tsv): iter1 k4/c16/n600 hr0.0000; iter2 k1/c16/n600 hr0.8260 (PSNR51.51); iter3 k2/c16/n600 hr0.0000; iter4 k1/c32/n600 hr0.8347 (PSNR51.96); iter5 k1/c32/n1200 hr0.8499 (PSNR52.80, ssim0.9985)=BEST. FINDINGS LOCKED: k=1 strongly optimal (k=2 and k=4 collapse to hr=0 -- extra DC steps corrupt on 128-view sparse breast); widening c16->c32 gave +0.009; doubling train_n 600->1200 gave +0.015 (data lever still climbing). (2) FAILURE MODE: at the k1/c32 champion the recon is already excellent (PSNR 52.8) and the residual gap to hr=1 is GENERALIZATION; the most recent proven-positive lever is TRAIN DATA (n600->1200 = +0.015) and c32 still trains to ~0 loss, so it is not yet data-saturated. (3) ONE KNOB: train_n 1200 -> 2400 (2x again; breast has 3600 train cases available). All else = iter-5 champion (k=1, c=32, alpha0.0026, residual False, lr2.5e-4, epochs15, patience15, grad_clip1.0, val_n200, seed42). (4) HYPOTHESIS: if train_n 1200->2400, hr rises above 0.8499 (diminishing but positive, toward ~0.86) because more diverse scenes further close the train-perfect/val-gap for the c=32 denoiser. FALSIFIER: hr <= ~0.851 (flat) => data saturated at 1200; iter-7 then pivots to denoiser DEPTH/width (architecture) rather than data. (5) BUDGET: 2400 scenes x15 epochs pretrain on cheap 128-view breast; iter-5 (n1200) ran ~235s, so ~2x ~ well under 1200s. (6) Self-driving to iter-20.
